[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Agent sudo requests with terminal-handoff authentication[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]An agent on any machine can request that Bryan authenticate an [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]exact, reviewed batch of sudo commands; authentication happens only[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]on a real TTY handed to sudo/PAM (never through SASE), execution [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]ssh -t remotely, a follow-up agent receives a structured ledger, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and athena's NOPASSWD sudo policy is tightened so the reviewed [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]approval becomes a real privilege boundary.[/#D7D7AF]
